title: Stabilize TanStack Router instance to prevent login input remount/flicker

requirements.summary: Prevent TanStack Router recreation in frontend/src/App.tsx by creating a single stable router instance and updating its auth context without remounting routes.
acceptanceCriteria: On the login page (`/`), typing into the "Your Name" input does not clear, does not lose focus, and does not visually blink/flicker on each keystroke.
The `LoginPage` component state (e.g., `displayName`) is preserved while typing (i.e., the route component is not remounted on each keystroke).

Navigation/route-guards still work correctly: unauthenticated users are redirected to `/` when attempting to access `/user/*` or `/admin/*`, and authenticated users can reach their dashboards as before.
No changes are made to any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

file_operations.description: Refactor router creation so `createRouter(...)` is not executed on every `AppContent` render (e.g., create the router once at module scope or store it in a `useRef` initialized once). Update the router's context when `isAuthenticated`/`isAdmin` change (without creating a new router) so `beforeLoad` guards continue to receive current auth state while routes/components are not remounted during unrelated renders (such as typing into the login form).
